title: Strategy recap
headline: Six proposed objectives and four target tiers give Gen Z and young adults (ages 18–29) the largest share of new effort, under a Center of Life position.

cols.title: Objectives [Proposed]
bullets: M1 Gen Z and young adults visit more often
M2 More tourists beyond China; M3 online-to-offline (O2O) conversion
M4 The 1 BIZ tenant partners; M5 sustainability as an asset
F1 Growth of 7.0% to 9.0% and a margin floor of 35.5% (team figures)

cols.title: Target markets
bullets: Primary: urban middle- to upper-income adults and families
Secondary: Gen Z, young adults (ages 18–29); largest new-effort share
B2B: global and local retail brands seeking prime sites

cols.title: Positioning
bullets: CPN's CFO calls CPN Thailand's leading place maker
Most Admired Company: No. 1 in shopping centres, 3 years running
Team positioning: Center of Life live-work-shop-stay developer
Backed by data personalisation and sustainability leadership

notes: Six proposed objectives. Marketing: more Gen Z visits, more tourists beyond China, online-to-offline conversion, The 1 BIZ partnerships, and sustainability as an asset. Financial: our figures are 7.0 to 9.0 percent growth and a 35.5 percent margin floor. Four target tiers rank our markets. Gen Z and young adults get the largest share of new effort. We position CPN as the Center of Life developer. Our third speaker takes the tactics.
